name: Matt Wheeler
background: Matt Wheeler of Hot Springs County ran in the 2026 Independent contest for county sheriff and lost the November general election. The official 2026 general election results list Republican Jerimie Kraushaar as the winner. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Hot Springs County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
